title: Gravity Lander
description: 3D precision lunar lander: manage thrust, rotation, fuel and wind to soft-land on 20 handcrafted and seeded pads for medals, plus a daily seeded challenge.

achievements.title: First Liftoff
achievements.desc: Fire the main engine for the first time.

achievements.title: Touchdown
achievements.desc: Land safely on a pad for the first time.

achievements.title: Golden Touch
achievements.desc: Earn Gold medals on 5 different pads.

achievements.title: Fumes
achievements.desc: Land safely with under 5% fuel remaining.

achievements.title: Efficient Pilot
achievements.desc: Land using less than 20% of your fuel budget.

achievements.title: Lithobraking
achievements.desc: Crash into the surface for the first time.

achievements.title: On A Roll
achievements.desc: Complete the Daily Challenge 3 days in a row.
